comparison.objective: Safely rout a curved board edge by bracing on a starting pin, pivoting onto the bearing, and feeding against cutter rotation.
comparison.physical_skill: Two-hand free-board control against cutter forces, pivoted engagement, curved feeding, and hazard clearance.
comparison.success_condition: Specified curved length is routed in the safe direction after a pin-braced start, the board clears the cutter, and hands remain outside the 3-inch hazard zone; an off-pin first bite irreversibly scores zero.
comparison.reason: This is force-controlled workpiece feeding around a guarded cutting tool, with no adjustable screw setting, jam-nut countertorque, or post-lock motion-retention test.
